description: G 55 4 with open faces on the cut blocks: the wavy channel of three 48 x 12 blocks (blocks 1 and 2 turned by 180 deg), hydrostatic semi-implicit (A 534 1): the discharge G 54 2 1 through the -i face of block 2 (its first piece) and a Riemann edge with a harmonic tide (B 520-523, B 522 1 1) on the +i face of block 1, which is the face of its second piece (piece 3); the blocks with open faces are cut along i. Without G 55 the same solution to 3e-9 (the eta solve).
covers: geo_mesh::face_piece for G 54 and B 522 (reefamr::blocks_open), lexer::amr_block of a piece (nhflow_momentum_SI::bc_method)
